name: Finale Research Manuscript
descriptionTemplate: Hand Limit +1. At turn start, if no Research has been conducted, choose an untried Research. Upon completion, gain the corresponding Research result from Doll: Inferno. After completing 3 Researches, place {derived:Illusion's End} into hand; this Relic becomes inactive.
